race.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: This represents a pretty big drop in grade for NIZAM and representing a yard with a superb record with similar types, he could be the way to go. Kokoluna and Metallo finished first and third in a C&D handicap recently and are respected, though a bigger threat may emerge in the shape of Caledonian . NIZAM (FR) CALEDONIAN KOKOLUNA
